edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the initial owner in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before setTransferable executes.
transfer reads and debits balances[msg.sender].
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key in allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
setTransferable writes the transferable flag.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
OYT constructor reads totalSupplyCap to seed the supply.
OYT constructor sets totalSupply.
OYT constructor credits balances[_issuer] with the full cap.
SafeMath.mul executes the raw multiplication a * b.
SafeMath.div executes the raw division a / b.
SafeMath.sub executes the raw subtraction a - b.
SafeMath.add executes the raw addition a + b.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] through SafeMath.sub.
transfer credits balances[_to] through SafeMath.add.
transferFrom debits balances[_from] through SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom credits balances[_to] through SafeMath.add.
transferFrom decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender] through SafeMath.sub.
transfer delegates balance debits to the SafeMath.sub library function.
transfer delegates balance credits to the SafeMath.add library function.
transferFrom delegates debits to the SafeMath.sub library function.
transferFrom delegates credits to the SafeMath.add library function.
_to is the destination address used by transfer.
_value is the amount subtracted from the sender balance in transfer.
_value is the amount added to the recipient balance in transfer.
_from selects the balance debited in transferFrom.
_to selects the balance credited in transferFrom.
_value is the amount subtracted from balances[_from] in transferFrom.
_value is the amount subtracted from the spender allowance in transferFrom.
_spender is the key written into the allowed mapping by approve.
_value is the allowance written by approve.
_owner becomes the new owner state variable.
_transferable is written into the transferable flag.
_issuer is the key credited in the balances mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: The destination parameter only exists to feed the transfer function's balances write and should be collapsed into it.
The _value parameter directly determines the guarded subtraction performed on the sender balance.
The _from parameter directly selects the balance that is debited in transferFrom.
The destination parameter only feeds the transferFrom balance credit and carries no separate semantics.
The _value parameter directly determines the guarded balance subtraction in transferFrom.
The _spender parameter only serves as a mapping key inside approve.
The _value parameter is written directly into the allowance mapping by approve.
The _owner parameter exists solely to be validated and stored by transferOwnership.
The _transferable parameter is written directly into the transferable state variable.
The _issuer parameter is only used to mint the entire supply cap in the constructor.
